objective: Freeze four mechanistically distinct risk/stability overlay implementations and all parameters before any performance evaluation on the Q031/Q032 PIT-validated universe.

shared_execution_contract.decision_timing: Risk state for session t uses only information available through close of session t-1.
shared_execution_contract.effective_timing: Overlay decision at t-1 close; applied from session t open.
shared_execution_contract.weight_normalization: No additional selection or renormalization except explicitly defined overlay scale.

families.name: sleeve_level_volatility_target
families.scale_rule: clip(target_volatility / lagged_realized_volatility, 0.25, 1.0); scale=1.0 with insufficient history or zero realized volatility.

families.name: portfolio_drawdown_state_throttle
families.state_rule: Drawdown <5%=1.0x; 5% to <8%=0.50x; >=8%=0.25x. After throttling, return to 1.0x only after drawdown <=3% for 5 consecutive completed sessions.

families.name: common_mode_correlation_cap

parameters.correlation_estimator: Pearson correlation of daily close-to-close returns

families.scale_rule: Mean off-diagonal pairwise correlation among currently positively weighted assets, using returns through t-1. If mean >=0.60, scale gross exposure to 0.50x; otherwise 1.0x.

families.name: position_lifecycle_tail_control

parameters.atr_definition: simple mean true range using the prior-session close
parameters.entry_rule: unchanged baseline positive allocation at monthly rebalance
parameters.reentry_rule: next monthly baseline rebalance after stop; reset trailing high

families.execution: Stop decision after completed close; position becomes flat from next session open.
families.provenance: Parameters and rule are inherited exactly from the prior fixed T045 lifecycle design; no Q031/Q032 performance information was used.
